name: app.sixfigs/sixfigs
title: Sixfigs
description: Sourced Grand Theft Auto VI facts: money methods and planner, vehicles, map, cheats, status.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Returns sourced facts about Grand Theft Auto VI from the Sixfigs dataset that match a query: player warnings, cheats, map locations, money methods, vehicles and release status. Use this when the user asks a factual question about the game that the other Sixfigs tools do not cover, such as cheats, missable content, save rules or where a place is. Covers Grand Theft Auto VI only; returns no result rather than a guess when nothing matches. Facts are compiled from named sources after the game's 19 Nov 2026 release; each result shows its status (official, confirmed, single-source or disputed), sources and verified date. Pass max_chapter to include content up to the player's chapter.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. "cash limit" or "cheats trophies".

max_chapter.description: Story chapter the player has reached. Content from later chapters is left out. Without it, major story spoilers are left out.

tools.name: get_money_methods
tools.description: Returns the ways to earn in-game money in Grand Theft Auto VI that are in the Sixfigs dataset, each with payout per run, time per run, dollars per hour where a run time is reported, unlock chapter and requirement, status and sources. Use this when the user asks how to make money in the game or how money methods compare. Ordered by reported dollars per hour; methods without a reported run time are listed separately without a rate. Pass max_chapter to leave out methods from later chapters. Facts are compiled from named sources after the game's 19 Nov 2026 release; each result shows its status (official, confirmed, single-source or disputed), sources and verified date.

max_chapter.description: Story chapter the player has reached. Content from later chapters is left out. Without it, major story spoilers are left out.

tools.name: plan_money
tools.description: Builds a money plan for Grand Theft Auto VI from the Sixfigs dataset: given the player's story chapter, a target amount and the minutes available, returns which methods to run, how many times, expected earnings, dollars per hour, unlock requirements and verified dates. Use this when the user wants to reach a specific amount of in-game money in a set time. Only methods unlocked by the given chapter, with a reported run time and not disputed, are planned; earnings use the lowest reported payout. The chapter also filters spoilers.

chapter.description: Story chapter the player has reached. Also used as max_chapter for spoiler filtering.

minutes.description: Real-time minutes the player has available.

tools.name: find_vehicles
tools.description: Returns Grand Theft Auto VI vehicles from the Sixfigs dataset that match a name or class: how and where to get each one, unlock chapter, edition requirements, and price, seats and top speed where sources state them, with status and sources. Use this when the user asks about a specific vehicle or a type of vehicle in the game. Fields no source states are left empty rather than estimated. Pass max_chapter to leave out vehicles from later chapters.

query.description: Vehicle name or part of it.

max_chapter.description: Story chapter the player has reached. Content from later chapters is left out. Without it, major story spoilers are left out.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Returns the release date, platforms, PC version status, online mode status and latest official patch of Grand Theft Auto VI, each with its source and verified date. Use this when the user asks whether the game is out, which platforms it is on, whether a PC version or online mode exists, or which patch is current. PC and online answers report announcement status only.
